current_text: The kettle's on and the pie is cooling. Neither is for you. Both are for you.

current_text: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.

current_text: Hm. Gate's never locked. Somebody might come home late.

current_text: Gossip: there's a cloak on a very muscly island. I've said too much. Hat!

current_text: They say one spring once fed all four Paths. Mixed, dear. Like a good soup.

current_text: IN THIS CORNER: MY LUNCH! (normal voice) It's soup. The soup is winning.

current_text: Business has been slow for ten years. Not my fault. Paperwork. Heh.

current_text: Never lift alone. An old man told me that. Never broke, they say. Huh.

current_text: Taste it. Go on. Somebody in this kingdom ought to taste something.

current_text: ...the green is hungry... Oh! Sorry. Did I thorn at you? I thorn when nervous.

current_text: The raccoons are very good boys. Don't tell them. They'll get ideas.

current_text: Three... two... oh, I already threw someone. Sorry. Enthusiasm.

current_text: Never once missed. The landing is your part. I believe in your part.

current_text: HNNNGH. Thank you for ripping with the Express. Please don't look at the seam.

current_text: Shirt number two hundred and thirteen. Very proud of it. Notice my form?

current_text: Rule one: never lift alone. Rule two... rule two is... where was I.

current_text: There was a boy at the Lifting Festival once. Four colours in his hands... hm.

current_text: Form 12-B for purchases. Filled in correctly? Oh. Oh, that's lovely.

current_text: Employee of the month since 1987, dear. The plaque is getting heavy.

current_text: Chef ALWAYS tastes. Always. That's how you know it's Chef.

current_text: Found, not stolen, dearie! The raccoon found it. I just held on tight. Heh!

current_text: A SMUDGE is TREASON! ...It's on me, isn't it. It's always on me.

current_text: The worms in my hat are unapproved. So am I. We get along.

current_text: Everything grows back, child. Even me. Especially me.
